description: Published v1 PlatformError codes and structured domain fallbacks. Messages are diagnostics, not localized product copy. Empty httpStatuses means operation-dependent. Use response.retryable, requestId and details rather than matching text. Future codes are additive; SDKs must preserve unknown codes.
